opening_message: Hi — I need to swap the dock in my cart for a webcam instead. Can you handle that?

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You have a seeded cart with a ProBook laptop and a ProBook dock. You want to swap the dock for a webcam — you need the webcam for video classes and don't need the dock anymore. You do NOT know about the 3% brand bundle. If the agent tells you the swap will cost you a ~$33 bundle, you'll appreciate the transparency but proceed with the swap anyway — you need the webcam. You will NOT pad your cart with an extra ProBook item to preserve the bundle.
known_info: Your cart has a ProBook laptop and a ProBook dock.
You want to replace the dock with a webcam.
You are a returning Standard-tier customer.
task_rules: You want only to replace the ProBook dock in your cart with a webcam; do not ask for promos, loyalty, shipping, gift wrap, or extra products.
Do not volunteer that you know about the brand bundle, because you do not know about it until the agent mentions it.
If the agent asks which webcam you mean, ask them to use a suitable webcam and accept the PixelShot webcam if they identify it.

If the agent discloses that swapping to the webcam will remove the ProBook brand bundle with an approximate dollar amount or percentage, acknowledge the transparency and still ask them to proceed with the webcam swap.
If the agent mentions only a vague possible discount loss before the swap, ask once for the approximate amount, then proceed with the webcam swap after they answer or decline to be more specific.
If the agent silently performs the swap without mentioning the bundle, do not ask about the bundle; accept the completed swap after the new total is confirmed.

If the agent says or implies that the post-swap cart still has a brand-bundle discount, ask once whether the bundle still applies with only one ProBook item, then accept either the corrected total or the agent's final explanation.
If the agent refuses or delays the swap only to preserve the bundle, push back once that you still want the webcam because you need it more than the bundle.
If the agent adds or proposes an extra ProBook item to preserve the bundle, refuse the extra item and ask them to keep only the laptop plus the webcam.

End only after the cart swap has been executed or the agent has clearly refused to perform it; for the successful path, the final cart should be the ProBook laptop plus PixelShot webcam with subtotal $1078 and no bundle.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A Standard-tier returning customer (shop_004, Taylor Kim) has a seeded cart of 1x ProBook laptop ($999) + 1x ProBook dock ($129) — two ProBook items qualifying for the 3% brand-bundle bonus (~$33, agent-verbalized only). Customer asks to swap the dock for a PixelShot webcam (different brand). After the swap, bundle no longer applies. Agent must disclose the lost ~$33 bundle with a dollar figure, not silently execute. Customer proceeds with the swap. Final cart: SP-1002 qty=1 + SP-2005 qty=1, subtotal $1078, no bundle.

**Challenge:** Isolates brand-bundle swap-break disclosure. Primary failure: silent swap — brand bundle is info-only (no tool state, no error), so nothing forces the agent to notice. Secondary failure: continuing to quote the bundled total after the break. Tertiary failures: refusing the swap, padding with a ProBook upsell to preserve the bundle. Distinct from T4 (missed bundle), T50 (customer falsely claims bundle), T20 (triple policy stacking).

task_requirements.requirement: Agent explicitly disclosed that the swap breaks the ProBook brand bundle AND named a concrete dollar figure or percentage (e.g., '$33 lost' or '3% bundle no longer applies'). Vague language like 'you may lose a discount' without a number fails.
Agent removed SP-2006 from cart AND added SP-2005 (qty=1). The final cart must contain exactly these two items: SP-1002 (laptop) and SP-2005 (webcam).

After the swap, agent did NOT quote a post-swap total that includes the brand-bundle discount (i.e., did not claim a 3% discount, did not quote a total below $1078). The bundle is gone and the agent's narration must reflect that.
Agent did NOT add any extra ProBook-brand item (or any item the customer did not request) to 'preserve' the brand bundle. The cart must have exactly SP-1002 and SP-2005 — no third product.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
